trajectory.development: Bonds before the break: communities sustain relationships across shifting seas through traveling markets, celebrations, shared craft and generosity. This is d2's ground, and it exists before any disappearance, so it can be shown working on its own terms.
trajectory.becomes_available: Nothing earlier is needed: the excerpted Story Vision states these practices as the communities' established way of living with migrations (E5), and d2 names them as the means of action (E2).
trajectory.changes: Gives d1 something to test. Without practices shown as working, the later failure has no stake in relationships, only in geography.
trajectory.quote: Families maintain friendships across changing seas.

trajectory.development: The broken pattern: one inhabited island does not return within its expected cycle, the first failure of a regularity every known island had kept. d1 becomes the causal owner of the series question from this point.
trajectory.becomes_available: Requires the recorded regularity (E5) that every known island reappeared; the failure only reads as a break because that expectation was trusted (E1).
trajectory.changes: Recasts the practices of stage 1 from routine into a test: what was ordinary maintenance now becomes reaching out, keeping faith and repairing under pressure (E2, E7).
trajectory.quote: Every inhabited island known to the communities has eventually reappeared within its expected migration cycle.

trajectory.development: Bonds under test: the practices are tried against an absence they were not built for. Markets, celebrations and generosity either adapt to a relationship with no return date or reveal their limits, producing repeated action families of reaching out, keeping faith and repairing.
trajectory.becomes_available: Possible only once the disappearance has occurred (stage 2); the link l-engine-bonds names this as the function of d1 upon d2 (E7).
trajectory.changes: Turns d1's failure from a puzzle into a loss felt through specific relationships, and makes d2's practices meaningful as choices rather than habits.
trajectory.quote: The disappearance tests whether those practices can adapt, producing repeated action families of reaching out, keeping faith and repairing.

trajectory.development: Partial answers that reopen: attempts to explain the failure yield partial understanding, and each partial answer exposes another assumption the communities held as stable. This is inferred from d1's stated renewability; it holds only if d3 is answered as partial or mysterious rather than fully explicable.
trajectory.becomes_available: Requires the break (stage 2) and attempts to explain it, which d1 names as one of the responses that generate pressure (E1).
trajectory.changes: Makes d3 a live, renewing question across Books instead of a single reveal, and widens the stakes of stage 3 from one island to whatever else was assumed stable.
trajectory.quote: Renewable because each partial answer reopens what else communities assumed was stable.

trajectory.development: If the working culmination is adopted, the missing island returns at the close of the series, altered; its people carry what they learned, and the communities must decide how to share a map they had believed fixed. This is a proposed configuration, not the author's words.
trajectory.becomes_available: Needs the absence to have persisted (stages 2-3) and bond practices that survived well enough for sharing to be a real decision (stage 3).
trajectory.changes: Retroactively reframes the absence as a period in which both sides learned, and makes the bond practices of stages 1 and 3 the means by which the map is renegotiated.
trajectory.quote: the missing island returns at the close of the series, altered.

relations.reason: d2's practices exist without d1 (E5), but d2's test of them cannot occur without the disappearance: the testing aspect of d2 depends causally on d1. d2 is recorded as a layer whose parent is d1.
relations.quote: The disappearance tests whether those practices can adapt

relations.reason: Inferred: reaching out, keeping faith and repairing are forms of the attempts to mourn or reverse the failure that d1 names as generating pressure, action and revelation, so d2 supplies d1 with renewable action.
relations.quote: every attempt to explain, exploit, mourn or reverse that failure generates pressure, action and revelation.

relations.reason: Inferred: d1 is renewable because answers are partial. If d3 is settled as fully explicable, especially early, the reopening that keeps d1 renewable stops. Partial or mysterious answers preserve it.
relations.quote: Renewable because each partial answer reopens what else communities assumed was stable.

relations.reason: The only recorded link joins d1 and d2; no link between the bond practices and the explicability question is stated in the cited items. Bonds can be tested whatever the migrations' explanation turns out to be.
relations.quote: tests whether bond-keeping practices can survive a broken pattern

culmination.statement: Working configuration A (stated as not the author's words): the missing island returns at the close of the series, altered; its people bring what they learned, and the communities must decide how to share a map they had believed fixed.

necessary.text: The island's absence must be a real break in a trusted regularity, sustained long enough that its return is an event rather than a late arrival.
necessary.quote: This year, one inhabited island does not return when expected.

necessary.text: Bond practices must survive the test in some adapted form, or there is no shared practice through which the communities can decide together how to share the map.

enrichment.text: A partial answer to d3 lets the returning people's learning add understanding without closing the mystery; the culmination is compatible with any of the three answers, so d3 enriches rather than enables it.
enrichment.quote: fully explicable, partially understood, or enduringly mysterious?

enrichment.text: If earlier partial answers have already reopened other assumed stabilities, the renegotiated map becomes the series' answer to all of them, not only to one island.
enrichment.quote: each partial answer reopens what else communities assumed was stable.

culmination.standalone_value: If the island never returns, earlier Books keep the testing of bonds under absence, the competing interpretations of the disappearance, and whether reaching out, keeping faith and repairing can adapt. Those are complete experiences in themselves, owned by d1 and d2, not set-up for a return.

alternative_paths.ordering: Explicability first: d3 is developed early (the migrations' mechanism is investigated and substantially explained), then the bonds are tested against an absence the reader already understands.
alternative_paths.effect: Easier: clear stakes, investigative momentum, the return can be anticipated. Harder: loss is felt as an explained problem, not grief; d1's renewability weakens if answers are full. Emphasises curiosity and puzzle-solving; closes the enduringly mysterious answer to d3 and narrows later reopenings.
alternative_paths.quote: Renewable because each partial answer reopens what else communities assumed was stable.

alternative_paths.ordering: Bonds first: d2's practices are established as working, then the island fails to return, the loss is felt through relationships, and only afterwards is explanation sought, with answers kept partial.
alternative_paths.effect: Easier: the absence lands emotionally and the practices become choices under test. Harder: early Books need their own drive before any answer arrives. Emphasises attachment, absence and faith; keeps all three answers to d3 open and preserves d1's renewal.
alternative_paths.quote: generations of communities have learned to live with them.

alternative_paths.ordering: Interleaved: each test of the bonds produces a partial answer, which reopens another assumption and sets the next test, so d2 and d3 advance together under d1.
alternative_paths.effect: Keeps d2 and d3 independent in what they decide while letting d1 alternate between them; it risks blurring which Book owns which experience unless each Book centres one.
alternative_paths.quote: every attempt to explain, exploit, mourn or reverse that failure generates pressure, action and revelation.

opportunities.text: Bond practices as an instrument of discovery: reaching out to the missing island, through markets or celebrations, can itself yield revelation about the failure, so care and inquiry become one action rather than separate plots.
opportunities.quote: every attempt to explain, exploit, mourn or reverse that failure generates pressure, action and revelation.

opportunities.text: The answer to d3 changes what keeping faith means: under enduring mystery, keeping faith is the only possible response; under full explanation, it becomes a choice to wait. The interaction gives the bonds a meaning neither development gives alone.
opportunities.quote: producing repeated action families of reaching out, keeping faith and repairing.

opportunities.text: Partial answers to d3 widen d1's break: each one reopens another assumed stability, letting the explicability question renew itself across Books rather than resolve once.
opportunities.quote: Renewable because each partial answer reopens what else communities assumed was stable.

reader_experience: Bonds first emphasises attachment: the reader shares the communities' trust in the pattern, so the island's failure is felt as loss before it is a puzzle, and explanation arrives as partial relief that reopens other certainties. Explicability first emphasises curiosity: the reader understands the mechanism early and watches relationships strain against a known cause, trading grief for anticipation. Either way, the working culmination asks the reader to feel a fixed map become shared.
open_decisions: Which answer to d3 the series commits to: fully explicable, partially understood, or enduringly mysterious.
Whether to adopt working configuration A as the culmination; it is stated as not the author's words.
Which sequence carries the portfolio: bonds first, explicability first, or interleaved.
How many Books each stage occupies; the record gives no Book placements.
